name: Chicken Kathi Roll
subtitle: the Calcutta original: egg paratha rolled around spiced chicken and raw onion

ingredients.qty: 3, half for cooking and half sliced raw

prepNotes: The roll was invented for eating on the move, so it is built to hold: egg layer, dry filling, tight wrap.
Keep the chicken dry. A wet filling turns the paratha to pulp before you finish it.

steps.text: Marinate the chicken strips in yogurt, ginger, garlic, chilli powder, turmeric and salt for at least 2 hours.
Make a soft maida dough with oil and water; rest 30 minutes.
Cook the chicken over high heat until the liquid has gone completely and the edges char, about 10 minutes.
steps.tip: Cook it dry. This is the single most important step.

steps.text: Roll and griddle the parathas until just cooked, keeping them soft.
Beat an egg, pour onto the tawa, press a paratha onto it, and flip after a minute.
Lay chicken along the edge with plenty of raw onion, green chilli, chaat masala and a hard squeeze of lemon.
Roll tight, wrap in paper and serve at once.

storage: Eat immediately. Cooked filling keeps 2 days refrigerated; dough keeps a day. Never assemble ahead.
